notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control at least one additional creature, or the permanent can tap to produce at least {2}.
description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Tishana.
When Tishana enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card for each creature you control.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 4 until you have at least {3} in your mana pool.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control additional creatures and/or the mana-producing permanent produces at least {2}, this combo nets near-infinite mana and near-infinite card draw.
